integrity: The core identity is obtained by exact differentiation of y²+z² and independently replayed by the included dependency-free polynomial checker. Numerical Lyapunov values from the source are used only for a conditional consistency illustration, not as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives necessary stationary and Lyapunov-sum constraints for compactly supported invariant measures; it does not prove existence, uniqueness, ergodicity, hyperchaos, mixing, or a complete attractor classification. The strict sign conclusions use b>0 and c>0.
title: Stationary height balance and Lyapunov-sum law in the Dong–Wang four-dimensional flow
